forms.name: help
forms.description: Explain available commands without contacting optional services.

forms.name: info
forms.description: Identify the local management program and its capabilities, not the human administrator or application health.

forms.name: status
forms.description: Start an all-authorized observation traversal over this owner's authoritative managed-resource inventory, including an empty inventory. Resolve and retain the permission-filtered selection once; source, client cache and optional directory data are not required.

forms.name: list
forms.description: Enumerate authorized retained operations with exact optional resource filtering and complete bounded continuation. Active selection preserves unresolved effects and holds even for terminal operations; retained history gaps are explicit. Discover non-effectful prepared capsules through workflow.list.

forms.name: show
forms.description: Inspect the outcome of the exact original request; absence of a reply does not prove absence of work.

forms.name: apply
forms.description: Submit the exact reviewed plan and digest using the current owner authority generation and original request identity; acknowledgement means accepted responsibility, not completed execution.

forms.name: plan-stdin
forms.description: Read the complete exact Subject from stdin and independently resolve this local owner identity. Stage the canonical PrepareRequest under plan-input custody and submit one bounded plan.prepare reference. Preserve the complete selection across upload interruption; no items are truncated or divided into separate Plans to fit a frame. The owner binds current principal, resource, owner epoch and byte identity before preparing the reviewable Plan.

forms.name: app-check
forms.description: Stage the exact one-application SelectionInput once under content custody and begin check. Observation cannot silently repair, adopt source, or authorize mutation; empty exact selections are separately representable through the request form.

forms.name: app-restart
forms.description: Plan a restart of the selected application under its already accepted release.

forms.name: app-repair
forms.description: Plan restoration of accepted application configuration without silently upgrading or replacing data.

forms.name: app-backup
forms.description: Plan a recovery capture after the receiving owner resolves the selected resource to its independently retained accepted application instance, release, complete preserve datasets and secret generations. Pin that exact BackupSelection in arguments.selection for review and revalidate it before capture; caller fields and source cannot approve themselves or adopt a different release. Capture success and restore-drill evidence remain distinct.

forms.name: cancel
forms.description: Request durable stop intent for the original Operation request named by the positional UUID; --request-id is the separate cancellation_id and --owner-epoch pins current authority. Return the immutable OperationCancellationReceipt with observed state and CLI request_id equal to cancellation_id. stop-requested acknowledges retained intent only; inspect the target Operation separately for current execution and cessation. already-terminal preserves a completion race. Lost replies retain the exact cancellation identity for get/list reconciliation and replay. No cancellation acknowledgment promises rollback, child termination or hold release.

forms.name: show-epoch
forms.description: Resolve the original request against the exact owner authority generation.

forms.name: workflow-show
forms.description: Inspect the exact retained owner capsule, including preparation before child operations exist.

forms.name: record-read
forms.description: Read one bounded chunk using the exact RecordReference, offset and length from closed stdin input. Reauthorize the actual receiving principal and protected snapshot scope; no reference is bearer authority.

forms.name: logs
forms.description: Read a bounded log page using exact owner epoch, resource, nullable opaque cursor and limit from closed stdin input. Every page, including an empty page, retains owner/resource identity and explicit continuation.

forms.name: owner-history
forms.description: Enumerate all authorized retained origin epochs through the independently authenticated current owner. The owner filters before disclosure. Opaque continuation pins current custodian, actual receiving principal, original filters and traversal snapshot. Revoked permission or a changed custodian invalidates continuation; a fresh client needs no previous epoch or client cache. Read the exact closed request from stdin.

forms.name: history-list
forms.description: Enumerate original immutable record references under one verified custody descriptor, using current principal permission. Native filtering retains terminal work with unresolved effects or holds, and non-effectful prepared workflow capsules. active_only is false for Plans, WorkflowTransferRecords and WorkflowPhaseAttestations. WorkflowTransferRecord enumeration returns the latest retained custody for every original transfer identity, including in-progress and completed transfers, with a workflow resource filter matched to record.resource. WorkflowPhaseAttestation enumeration returns every retained original attestation identity under the same exact workflow resource filter, including expired proofs. Its original request, authenticated attribution, issuer epoch, observed generation, signed proofs and expiry remain immutable; historical inspection never renews protection or authorizes current phase progress. Both record kinds retain their original schema closures and require independently installed historical readers when the installed closure differs. Original epochs, generation, accepted input, phase witnesses and completion receipts remain unchanged across restoration; later transfers or attestations never hide earlier identities. A page is not a total collection cap; permission, exact filters and custody remain pinned across continuation. References disclose no execution authority. WorkflowJournalRecord enumeration includes every original immutable event, including initialization, retained projections, bindings, permits, outcomes, transfer and recovery events. active_only is false. A null resource discovers all authorized journal events and their workflow identities without saved client IDs; a workflow resource filters exactly that workflow. Pagination pins a stable high-water event boundary, current custodian, custody descriptor, actual principal and exact filters. New retained events cannot replace or rebind a cursor prefix. Expired cursors fail explicitly and a fresh traversal rediscovers all retained events. The owner uses retained indexes and bounded scan windows, including denied entries, rather than rescanning a complete journal per page. Original accepted inputs are discovered from each event reference through history.input and read through history.content. Read the exact closed request from stdin.

forms.name: history-read
forms.description: Read exact original snapshot bytes after current-owner authorization of its protected resource and verified custody membership. The reference retains the original owner epoch and exact installed historical schema closure. It cannot register a reader or authorize new work. Read the exact closed request from stdin.

forms.name: history-input
forms.description: Resolve the exact original accepted command of a retained journal event discovered by history.list. The current custodian independently authenticates its verified restoration membership and current principal permission for the original workflow before disclosing anything. The reference retains the original owner epoch, immutable event identity and exact historical schema. No original staging handle or client cache is required. A caller cannot select another command, install a historical reader, revive execution authority or turn an unknown record into accepted work. Read the exact closed request from stdin.

forms.name: history-content
forms.description: Read original retained input or result bytes after current-owner authorization of the handle's protected resource and its membership in the verified restoration closure. A known handle or former principal permission is insufficient. Original handle identity and digest remain unchanged; complete bytes must be verified before use. Read the exact closed request from stdin.

forms.name: plan-get
forms.description: Read the exact closed owner/plan_digest lookup from stdin. All fields are discoverable from the accepted Operation. Current read authorization and retained immutable Plan identity apply even after its admission deadline; client state is not required.

forms.name: observe-request
forms.description: Read one closed StartRequest or ContinueRequest. Exact selection uses complete committed content; all-authorized resolves the owner inventory once. Continuation carries no repeated resource list.

forms.name: check-request
forms.description: Read one closed StartRequest or ContinueRequest for observational checks, with exact staged selection or all-authorized inventory and bounded retained continuation.

forms.name: cancellation-show
forms.description: Read a closed cancellation GetRequest from stdin and retrieve the original accepted decision under current read permission. Its target request_id and cancellation_id stay distinct. Read the target Operation separately; replay does not freshen the original decision or grant stopping authority. The request names original owner and current custodian; restored reads also name independently verified custody_id and never revive old stop intent.

forms.name: cancellation-list
forms.description: Read a closed cancellation ListRequest from stdin and discover all retained cancellation decisions for an original Operation request without knowing cancellation IDs. Follow opaque continuations with the same owner, target, principal and limit. Expiry fails explicitly; page completion does not prove absence of concurrent future intent. For restored history, first discover custody with owner.history and the original Operation request_id with history.list/read, then select that origin and current custodian with the verified custody_id.

forms.name: lifecycle-evidence-prepare
forms.description: Stage the complete canonical lifecycle evidence PrepareRequest through lifecycle-input custody and request one observational snapshot. Preserve its preparation identity across retries. Return the finite typed immutable evidence reference; full content remains readable through content.get and any consuming retained Plan/Operation. Preparation does not retire, discharge or delete anything.

forms.name: content-read
forms.description: Read the exact handle, offset and bounded length supplied on standard input through the same protected content.get use case. Return an observed typed ContentChunk with the full handle and range. Preserve the independently retained handle across every chunk, check contiguous progress, then verify complete size and digest before interpreting evidence. A read does not admit an operation, grant authority, refresh retention or prove the contained task succeeded.

forms.name: workflow-journal-submit
forms.description: workflow.journal.submit carries a content-staged canonical JournalCommand under exact receiving owner, workflow scope, current principal, digest and byte length. Replies are immutable typed record references, read through bounded record.read chunks with current scope authorization on every read. Lost replies rediscover the original request outcome by ID. Upload and download interruption retain complete extent and resume offsets; frame/page limits do not cap total owners, children, material or history. Request-selected schema readers or trust keys are forbidden.

forms.name: workflow-journal-get
forms.description: Retrieve the original signed local or gate journal outcome by its immutable record ID. Current owner and workflow scope authorization applies. Inspecting a record grants no native execution authority.

forms.name: workflow-journal-list
forms.description: Discover all authorized owner-local workflow journal heads without client state. Follow every continuation to cover the complete selected set.

forms.name: workflow-journal-list-next
forms.description: Resume the same stable local journal traversal with current disclosure permission; the page limit is not a collection limit.

forms.name: workflow-journal-events
forms.description: Enumerate every retained local journal event through a stable high-water boundary. Follow all pages to recover initialization, gate route, child permits, original outcomes and recovery custody without original client IDs. Current disclosure scope is checked on every page.

forms.name: workflow-journal-events-next
forms.description: Enumerate every retained local journal event through a stable high-water boundary. Follow all pages to recover initialization, gate route, child permits, original outcomes and recovery custody without original client IDs. Current disclosure scope is checked on every page.

forms.name: workflow-journal-input
forms.description: Retrieve immutable original accepted input custody by outcome ID; bounded content reads reauthorize exact owner and workflow scope.
